question: I105
title: demand-grown granule claws vs v44 random claws at granN 8000: book10k, book30k, fables4000, order3, K4, text1000, seqchoice order2 / cycle, fresh k 2784-2799

accept.note: Hypothesis: demand-grown claws from repeated co-occurrence vs random sparse claws at the same N. Do NOT adopt from this job. v44 / DEFAULTS_VERSION 37 stay. Read it with the 16-growth rule (no task worse: losses not > 60%, t > -2) only together with granAsg near 8000 (matched final cell count). granAsg / granRec / granPend are in the r42 stats. Arm is P.granDemand=1, P.granCo=2, P.granRecycle=1 (least-used granule past the grace window is rewritten when the pool is full). Seqchoice grows no granule layer; it is the unchanged-task check.
